02_company_identity.intro_30_words: Apex Precision Machinery is a premier ISO 9001 certified manufacturer of Industrial Machinery & CNC Automation, delivering precision engineered solutions compliant with ISO 230-2 and CE-MD (2006/42/EC).
02_company_identity.intro_100_words: Apex Precision Machinery operates an advanced 28,000 m² smart manufacturing facility specializing in high-performance Industrial Machinery & CNC Automation. Backed by ISO 230-2 and CE-MD (2006/42/EC) accreditations, our facility integrates inline optical inspection with AQL 0.65 standards. We partner with Tier-1 contractors, global brand specifiers, and wholesale distributors across 40+ countries.
02_company_identity.intro_300_words: Apex Precision Machinery represents the gold standard in export-grade Industrial Machinery & CNC Automation. Founded to bridge the gap between heavy industrial reliability and agile OEM/ODM customization, our facility houses 4 automated production lines and a certified in-house physical testing laboratory. Every batch undergoes strict environmental and mechanical endurance verification, achieving ±0.003 mm (±0.00012"). Our dedicated engineering team provides rapid 3D CAD/CAM prototyping in 7–10 days with complete Mill Test Certificates (MTC).
